notes.title: Update - Beta 1.1.3.8
notes.content:
[b]So well...
sorry for missing so many patchnotes.[/b]

I've spend a lot of time to remove the bugs i got by changing some basic settings of the game. there where so many hotfixes and little updates, witch i didn't list here. I just did not found time to do that. 
[list]
    [*]Optimized the rods rendering, position and precision.
    [*]Replaced a lot of textures and improoved the materials.
    [*]Fixed the multiplayer lag on clientside a lot.
    [*]Changed the default windowmode to fullscreen ( recommended for hosting multiplayer games).
    [*]Changed the balls physics and collision settings.
    [*]Changed the names and difficulty for the AI in singleplayer.
    [*]Added a replay tool with some basic functions to review the matches you have played.
    [*]Transitionally disabled the goal replays while playing.
    [*]Improoved the keepers AI movement range and alignment.
    [*]Several other small bugfixes.
[/list]

tags.bug: [*]Fixed the multiplayer lag on clientside a lot.

tags.feature: [*]Added a replay tool with some basic functions to review the matches you have played.

notes.title: Update - Beta 1.0.5.0.
notes.content:
[h1]Patch - Beta 1.0.5.0. has been released for Virtual Foosball[/h1]
[list]
[*]Reduced AI shooting power.
[*]Smoothed the input and movement for the clinet in multiplayer.
[*]Fixed AI do not shoot while ball is in range.
[*]Fixed replay is playing 2 or 3 times.
[*]Set teamcolor to non metallic if enabling glowing mod.
[*]Changed ball and rods physic and collision settings.
[*]Worked out the tables mesh a bit.
[*]Replaced the tableframes wood textures.
[*]Several small bugfixes.
[/list]

notes.title: Update - Beta 1.0.1.0.
notes.content:
Patch - Beta 1.0.1.0. has been released for Virtual Foosball. 

- Added a little Tutorial to understand how to play the game.
- Changed the mouseinput settings.
- Optimized the network traffic.
- Added an automatic match restart, if you are changing the AI difficulty level.
